title: Sparkly pear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pear body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='26' ry='28' fill='#7BC142'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='26' ry='28' fill='none' stroke='#9CD65A' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- pear highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='57' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#A8E06A' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- pear top/neck -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#7BC142'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='14' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#9CD65A' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- pear neck highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='39' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#A8E06A' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 32 Q52 24 56 20' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stem highlight -->
  <path d='M50 32 Q52 25 55 21' stroke='#B87A3E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M52 26 Q62 18 68 22 Q64 30 54 30 Z' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <path d='M52 26 Q62 18 68 22' stroke='#7DD87D' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE066'>
    <!-- sparkle 1 top-left -->
    <path d='M20 22 L22 28 L28 30 L22 32 L20 38 L18 32 L12 30 L18 28 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 2 top-right -->
    <path d='M78 18 L79.5 23 L84 24.5 L79.5 26 L78 31 L76.5 26 L72 24.5 L76.5 23 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 3 bottom-left -->
    <path d='M16 70 L17.5 75 L22 76.5 L17.5 78 L16 83 L14.5 78 L10 76.5 L14.5 75 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 4 bottom-right -->
    <path d='M82 72 L83.5 77 L88 78.5 L83.5 80 L82 85 L80.5 80 L76 78.5 L80.5 77 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 5 small right -->
    <circle cx='88' cy='48' r='3'/>
    <!-- sparkle 6 small left -->
    <circle cx='12' cy='52' r='3'/>
    <!-- sparkle 7 tiny top -->
    <circle cx='62' cy='14' r='2.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle glints in white -->
  <g fill='#FFF9CC'>
    <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='24.5' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='16' cy='76.5' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='78.5' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
